errors.evidence: The chart displays seven categories of soft skills, not six. The categories listed later in the description correctly count to seven.

errors.text_span: подредени по хоризонталната ос в азбучен ред
errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted alphabetically. The first letters of the categories are Р, Е, Г, П, Д, П, К, which is not an alphabetical sequence.
This is the range of the data values shown on the bars, not the range of the y-axis itself. The y-axis has no visible tick marks or range labels.

errors.text_span: с етикетиране на стойностите с интервали от 0,01
errors.evidence: The vertical axis does not have intervals of 0.01. This is a confusing and incorrect description of the axis scale. The data labels have a precision of 0.01, but these are not axis intervals.
The legend is located at the top center of the chart, not in the top right corner.

errors.text_span: всички стълби са еднакво изобразени по височина и толщина
errors.evidence: Stating that the bars are 'equally depicted in height' ('еднакво изобразени по височина') is factually incorrect for a bar chart, as the height of the bars represents the different data values. Only the thickness/width is uniform.
